why_the_gate_fails.note: Small's converged state reaches basin median rank 13 while sitting ~2.4 degrees off orthogonal to the socialist embedding direction. The register is a very weak, distributed component of the readout, so any lossy map erases it.

embedding_centroid_readouts.note: In neither model does averaging the socialist embeddings read out as socialist; Small's basin is not a centroid artefact.
